name: Arrows
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Arrows are bought in lots of 20 for 1 GP, weighing 1 pound for the lot; Quiver storage is separate. An Ammunition attack spends one piece, drawing as part of attack; one free hand loads a one-handed weapon. After a fight, spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition used, rounded down; the rest is lost.
